text.tspan: Partner access: they assume a role in OUR account (no IAM users, no keys)
s3://our-exports/acme/ · CloudTrail logs every call as the role session
tags: owner, partner, expires=2027-03-31 · Access Analyzer shows it as external access
Both sides must allow it: our trust policy AND their identity policy. Alternatives: resource policy (bucket / KMS / SQS),
AWS RAM (subnets, TGW), S3 Access Points, pre-signed URLs, IAM Roles Anywhere (workload outside AWS).
Never Principal "*" with only an ExternalId. MaxSessionDuration 1-12 h; role chaining caps it at 1 h.
